title: Head of Data, Analytics & Data Science
description: We're seeking a Head of Data, Analytics & Data Science to lead our data strategy end-to-end: analytics, BI, and applied data science. This role blends hands-on technical leadership with strategic ownership of our Google Cloud data platform, Tableau-based analytics, and predictive and optimization use cases. Responsibilities include: Define and own data strategy, lead data platform on GCP/BigQuery, design scalable data pipelines, own Tableau dashboards, lead applied data science including parcel volume forecasting and network optimization, build and lead data team. Qualifications: 8+ years experience, proven team leadership, hands-on Tableau expertise, strong GCP/BigQuery, advanced SQL, Python for analytics, predictive modeling experience.
